name: Code / custom Liquid
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Code / custom Liquid. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Mode
settings.info: All modes use the native Shopify Custom Liquid field. This choice supplies editor guidance; Embed also bounds embedded media.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Custom code
settings.how: Advanced: add trusted Liquid or HTML only when native settings cannot meet the need. Work in a duplicated unpublished theme. Do not paste credentials, untrusted scripts, or a second product form inside purchase controls.

settings.label: Fallback message
settings.default: Add custom code, Liquid, or embed content here.
settings.how: Enter the fallback message. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Contain overflow
settings.how: Turn on “Contain overflow” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show editor warning

settings.label: Warning text
